thread:
sara_support: FYI customer 'goodbook' reporting 503s on hosted infer since ~10:25 UTC. CS says most requests hit 'upstream' and return 503. Logs show runner restarts. Please triage. thread_ts=3491234567
kevin_oncall: looking...
kevin_oncall: saw restarted pods in pool gpu-a, restartCount=3. Kernel log shows CUDA OOM then segfault on infer-runner binary.
kevin_oncall: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-17T10:25:42Z] infer-runner[pid=1234]: ERROR runtime: cudaMalloc failed: out of memory
[2026-03-17T10:25:43Z] infer-runner[pid=1234]: signal 11 (SIGSEGV), address 0x0
kubelet: container runtime set to exitCode 139, restarting
```
mike_infra: model variant redwood-v1-7b-q4 was on that pool. We recently enabled aggressive KV prefetch and batch_map window. Suspect mem growth when long contexts + batch_size>16.
jon_prod: can confirm: canary metrics show 48% 503s for that variant. We have fallback to cpu-small but it wasn't triggered because routing policy prefers same model; let's enable fallback to model:redwood-v1-7b-int8 for hosted-api.
sara_support: can we get repro steps to confirm? customer willing to test.
kevin_oncall: repro steps I used:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v1-7b-q4","input":"'$(python -c "print('A'*14000)")'","max_tokens":256,"batch_size":32}'
```
kevin_oncall: that triggers OOM and container restart locally in hosted pool.
mike_infra: mitigation: update pool config to cap max_batch_size=8 and disable kv_prefetch for pool gpu-a. commands:
```
# patch pool
redwoodctl pools patch gpu-a --set max_batch_size=8 --set kv_prefetch.enabled=false
# drain and restart pods
kubectl -n hosted rollout restart deploy/infer-runner-gpu-a
```
deploy-bot: rollback/patch applied by mike_infra — rollout started (deployment/infer-runner-gpu-a)
ops-bot: autoscaler reduced target pods by 2 while restarting
jon_prod: longer term we should add mem accounting guard and a prefetch cap per-request. I'll file a PR to add a defensive OOM fence and reduce prefetch window.
sara_support: updated customer, enabled fallback routing to int8 variant, set P1, scheduled join with infra for 11:00 UTC for root cause. Thanks all :thumbsup:
